title: Interpretable Synthetic Tabular Data Generation with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
summary: A bachelor's thesis project that replaces the MLP blocks inside TVAE and CTGAN with Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (MultKAN) layers to build interpretable, prunable synthetic tabular data generators for a clinical heart-disease dataset. The repository vendors and modifies CTGAN's synthesizer code and its rdt-based DataTransformer (ClusterBasedNormalizer, OneHotEncoder) directly from the SDV family, adapting SDV's TVAE and CTGAN implementations as the base architecture for the KAN experiments.
